description: Search catalog publishers by name or identifier value. Anonymous and read-only; served by the bibliograph edge from the catalog tables. Results are ordered by exact-name match, then name prefix, then substring, with a stable name/URI tie-break.

q.description: Text to match against the publisher's name and identifier values. Case-insensitive substring match; a blank value is rejected.

limit.description: Maximum number of publishers to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. A malformed cursor restarts at the beginning rather than erroring.
Opaque cursor for the next page; absent when no more matches exist.
